facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition and Administration Reform (MTNRA) budget for 2024 is MAD 2,032.4m: personnel 85.841m, materials and miscellaneous 187.840m, investment 1,758.725m (total summed from the page's three chapters).

The MTNRA budget rose from MAD 1,508.4m in 2023 (71.842m personnel, 187.297m materials, 1,249.225m investment) to MAD 2,032.4m in 2024 (totals summed from the page's chapters); investment alone rose from 1,249.2m to 1,758.7m.

note: Standing ministry page with no date; the 2024 year is the latest it reports, so as_of is 2024.
